system.description:
The leaf ninja stops in his tracks as a masked figure blocks the path forward. The leaf ninja pauses, mistaking the potential of their opponent. The figure then forms a strange hand sign as waves of energy saturate the air and a brightly colored wreath of chakra manifests behind them. As if looking at the distant sun, the chakra donned by this mysterious ninja sends flares of light the leaf ninja must squint through. "Incredible chakra!?" the leaf ninja tensely describes. The aura reaches its height as it takes shape to form a large tail of feathers. The tension is cut by another approaching who urges, "Wait! Stand down! This one is on our side ".

— Makuzoyashi Hanami,

The Miracle Bindings, Ch. 2, excerpt.

Star Training

Member of the Hoshi clan are members of a rather small family of survivors from the reign of the Star Meteor. Your family were one of the few survivors of the initial training phases before it was destroyed during the Star Guard Crisis. Your family has sense left the land of Bears and settled down in one of the surrounding elemental lands giving you an opportunity to bring honor and pride back to Hoshigakure.

Hoshi Traits

Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Con, +1 Int

Speed: 30 feet

Skill Proficiency: Chakra Control, Ninshou

Hoshi Techniques: The Hoshi Clan has access to a separate list of Jutsu unique to their Clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the Normal jutsu list(s).

Hoshi Features

Star Chakra

1st Level Clan Feature

The meteorite that helped found Hoshigakure did not simply fall from the sky, it warped the realities of all who found themselves in its orbit. Your bloodline has absorbed and metabolized this meteoric chakra granting you access to Star Chakra, a powerful and volatile alien chakra. You have a maximum pool of Star Chakra equal to 1 + your Proficiency bonus. You regain Star Chakra in one of two ways;

When you complete a short or long rest.

As a Bonus Action on your turn, drawing out as much Star Chakra as you desire. Regain a number of Star Chakra up to your maximum.

Star Chakra can be spent for features and jutsu that call for it. If you cast a jutsu using Star Chakra, it gains its Irradiated effect. Also, all temporary chakra you gain is converted into Temporary Star Chakra.

Temporary Star Chakra works like normal Temporary Chakra, but only for Hoshi clan features, abilities and Jutsu that spend Star Chakra. Temporary Star Chakra can stack unlike Temporary Chakra, but is always lost at the end of your following turn.

This Star Chakra while powerful, doesn’t come without risk, being hazardous to its users, inducing a mysterious sickness for overuse.

When you begin your turn, and have, since the beginning of your previous turn, spent or drawn out 4 or more Star Chakra, you gain 1 rank of Star Sickness. Beginning at 7th level, this penalty triggers if you spend 5 or more Star Chakra. Beginning at 15th level, this penalty triggers if you spend 6 or more Star Chakra.

Kujaku Peacock Plume

1st Level Clan Feature

The first and most prominent ability Hoshi clansmen unlock, the ability to materialize their Star Chakra in the shape of a beautiful peacock plumage.

As a Bonus action, you can activate Kujaku Mode for the next minute, or until you dismiss it on your turn at no action cost. Once you use this mode, you cannot use it again until you complete a short rest.

While in this mode, you suppress the penalties and negative effects of Star Sickness for the duration.

Celestial Body

3rd Level Clan Feature

You families deep connection to the original meteor has allowed you to be birthed with a stronger than normal physique and a slightly more toxic chakra network. You begin with resistance to Chakra damage and immunity to effects that increase the chakra cost of jutsu you cast or maintain concentration on. In addition to this, you also have other traits unique to your Star village heritage, simply called Celestial Traits. You begin with one of these traits, gaining an additional trait at 7th and 15th levels.

Celestial Traits that forces a saving throw, uses your highest jutsu save DC.

Meteoric Reflection

When a hostile creature within 30 feet deals damage to you as a result of a Ninjutsu they cast, you can spend your reaction and multiples of 2 Star Chakra to reflect some if back. When their damage is rolled, select a number of damage die, starting from the highest die rolled for every 2 Star Chakra spent, removing it from their damage total, and adding it to the Reflection total. The triggering creature takes force damage equal to the removed damage die + 2d12.

Radiation Barrier

When a hostile creature deals damage to you as a result of a melee attack, your Star Chakra lashes out attempting to irradiate everything in your immediate area. As a reaction, you can spend multiples of 2 Star Chakra, forcing the triggering creature to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the affected creature takes 2d6 poison damage and 1 rank of Weakened for every 2 Star Chakra spent.

Celestial Pulse

When a hostile creature forces you to make a saving throw to resist a Genjutsu they cast that you are aware of, your Star Chakra lashes out attempting to disrupt the intrusion of chakra. As a reaction, you can spend multiples of 2 Star Chakra, as part of this saving throw. For every 2 Star Chakra spent, you gain a rank of Mastery to that saving throw results.

Star Threads

As a Bonus action, you can spend multiples of 2 Star Chakra targeting one willing allied creature within 30 feet of you for every 2 Star Chakra spent. Each creature targeted has a thin thread of star chakra attached to them for the next minute or until they end their movement more than 60 feet away from you, or they gain full cover against you.

For the duration, they gain resistance to chakra damage, and make saving throws to resist effects that raise the chakra cost of jutsu they cast at advantage.

Irradiated Imprint

As part of casting a Hoshi Hijutsu that targets or affects a hostile creature, you can spend multiples of 2 Star Chakra for every creature that makes a saving throw against the jutsu cast. You mark each creature that makes this saving throw, regardless if they pass or fail the save. They remain marked until the end of your next turn.

If a marked creature ends their next turn within 20 feet of you, they suffer potent radiation poisoning, taking 2d6 poison damage + an additional 2d6 poison damage, for every other marked creature that ends their turn within 20 feet of you.

Meteoric Pressure

If a hostile creature moves within 20 feet of you, you can spend your Reaction and 4 Star Chakra to force all creatures within 20 feet of you to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they are overwhelmed by the radiating potency of your chakra, having their movement reduced to 0 until the end of the current turn and they gain 2 rank of Weakened and are Bruised.

Cosmic Siphon

When a hostile creature within 30 feet of you casts a Jutsu that have both the Hand Sign (HS) and Chakra Molding (CM) components, that you can see, you can spend your reaction to irradiate their chakra, before siphoning it back into yourself. As a reaction, spend multiples of 2 Star Chakra. For every 2 Star Chakra spent, they increase the chakra cost of the jutsu they cast by +4, and you roll 1d6, recording the die result. You gain Temporary Star Chakra equal to the result.

Meteoric Dowsing

7th Level Clan Feature

The meteorite that birthed your clans power left behind a legacy of destruction, both of your enemies, and yourself. But you’ve learned to point and aim that destruction at things normally resilient to direct harm.

By spending 10 minutes in contact with a creature suffering from a Curse, or an object, structure or creature marked with a Complex Seal, you can feed your Star Chakra into it, weakening either, reducing the DC needed to help dispel them by 5. If you can spend at least 1 hour doing this, you can instead dispel a Complex Seal, and heavily weaken the Curse, causing it to be suppressed for the next 24 hours.

Meteoric Attunement

11th Level Clan Feature

You have lived with Star Chakra long enough for it to no longer function like a foreign energy source. It is part of you now, regardless of the potential harm.

Beginning at 11th level, twice per Full-Rest, when you complete a Short or Long Rest, you can reduce your Star Sickness by 1 rank.

Additionally, your Star Chakra has developed into its own network of chakra that acts as a passive sensory system for you. You gain the following benefits:

You gain the Sense Chakra special action, modified by your Star Chakra.

You make the Identify Genjutsu check at advantage.

You are always aware of creatures within 30 feet of you that are concentrating on Jutsu or casting a jutsu with the Chakra Molding (CM) component, except through walls or barriers.

Sense Chakra. You can make a Perception check using Intelligence vs the Chakra control DC of all creatures within 30 feet of you. On a success, you gain the benefit of the Chakra Sensing special sense against them for the duration until they either have 0 chakra or they make and succeed their Suppress Chakra skill action.

Irradiated Apex

15th Level Clan Feature

You have pushed further than any Hoshi has before. Your use of Star Chakra grants you the chance, for one brilliant catastrophic moment, to become the Star your clan looks to for guidance.

When you spend 6 or more Star Chakra between the beginning of your most recent turn and the beginning of your next turn, you enter your Kujaku Sanseiijin (Brilliant Peacock Star Formation) state until the end of your next turn. You cannot extend the duration of this state if you are already in it, meaning even if you spend an additional 6 or more Star Chakra while in this state, it still ends at the predefined time.

| #### Kujaku Sanseijin / Fortitude Amp / Your chakra made tail feathers are more beautiful than you could imagine. / Brilliant Plumage. You gain the benefits of Kujaku Mode for the duration. / Stars Momentum. You gain the Star Momentum special action once per activation of this state. You can use this special action to cast or use any Hoshi Clan Hijutsu or Celestial Trait, that costs an Action, Bonus Action or Reaction. / Irradiated Reflexes. All Hoshi clan Hijutsu you cast for the duration, gain their Irradiated Effect, without spending additional Star Chakra. / Star Control. Star Chakra you spend while in this state, does not count towards gaining Star Sickness. |
